title: Tilt & revenge trading
subtitle: Breaking the loop before it breaks your account

scenes.say: One bad loss, then another, then a reckless trade to win it back. That's tilt. Here's how to stop the spiral.

scenes.title: The tilt loop
scenes.say: Tilt is a loop. A loss stings, emotion takes over, and you take a revenge trade with bigger size and no real setup. That leads to a bigger loss, and the loop starts again.

items.label: Emotion
items.sub: Anger, fear, the urge to get even

scenes.title: Warning signs
scenes.say: Learn your warning signs: trading faster than usual, raising size to win it back, skipping the checklist, and staring at your profit and loss instead of the chart. When you notice them, name the feeling before you click.
points: Raising size to win it back

els.sub: Name the feeling before you click

scenes.title: Break the loop
scenes.say: To break the loop: stop, take your hands off the mouse, and step away for at least fifteen minutes. When you come back, halve your risk, or stop for the day after three losses. Then write it down in your journal.

items.label: Cut risk
items.sub: Halve it, or stop after 3 losses

scenes.title: Decide in advance
scenes.say: The secret is to decide before you trade, not during. Set your daily loss limit and stop rules while you're calm. The tilt guard in this app reads your journal and reminds you when to slow down.

els.sub: Set your loss limit and stop rules while you're calm. The tilt guard enforces them.

scenes.title: Recap
scenes.say: Remember: a loss is a business cost, not a debt you must repay today. Protect your mind and your account, and tomorrow's setups will still be there.

els.text: A loss is a cost, not a debt
els.sub: You never have to win it back today.
